policy.sdkVersioning: The SDK version tracks the engine minor version (0.6.x). Engine builds ship to players through the runtime updater; the SDK is not re-cut per build. An integration built against 0.6.0 links against any 0.6.x runtime.
policy.supportWindow: The current SDK minor and the one before it are supported. Older minors are archived and receive no fixes; partners on an archived minor should contact partner support before upgrading.

channels.eval: Public. No account, no key, no driver. Compiles and runs, simulates detections, protects nothing.
channels.partner: Delivered through the partner portal after key issuance. Contains the signed driver and the production libraries. Never published on this site.
channels.alpha: Engine builds under active development, currently v0.6.x. Partner titles in closed beta run these through the runtime updater.
channels.beta: The last stable engine line, v0.5.1.x. Still receiving signature updates while partners migrate.

artifacts.name: Cerberus Readiness Check
artifacts.summary: A single PowerShell script that runs 14 local checks and tells a player whether their PC can run a Cerberus-protected title, with OEM-generic fix-it steps for anything that fails. Offline: no network access, no telemetry, no installer.
artifacts.runtime: Windows PowerShell 5.1 (built into Windows) — nothing to install
contents: Cerberus-ReadinessCheck.ps1 — the check itself, 14 checks, plain text and readable
README.md — what each check means, how to verify the script is offline, exit codes
SHA256SUMS.txt — checksums for every file in this archive

artifacts.name: Cerberus Evaluation SDK
artifacts.summary: The complete public SDK header with a local implementation you can compile, run and integrate against without an account. No driver, no key, no network, no detection — the API surface and behaviour are identical to the partner runtime, so nothing in your integration changes when the runtime is swapped in.
artifacts.runtime: CMake 3.16+, MSVC 2019 16.11+ or Clang 13+; optional .NET 8 for the C# binding
contents: include/cerberus_sdk.h — the complete public API, compiles as C99 and C++17
CMakeLists.txt — cerberus_eval static library, optional cerberus_sdk shared library, both examples
SHA256SUMS.txt — checksums for every file in this archive
notIncluded: The signed kernel driver — Layer 1 does not load
Production libraries with detection in them
An API key, or any connectivity to a region
Hardware attestation — CerberusAttestation is returned zeroed

artifacts.name: Cerberus Partner Runtime
artifacts.deliveredVia: Partner portal, after key issuance and a signed agreement. The signed driver and the production libraries are never published on this site — there is no public URL to fetch them from, gated or otherwise.
artifacts.summary: The shipping package: the EV code-signed kernel driver (WHQL certification pending), the production static and import libraries, the engine integration plugins, and an issued API key scoped to your title.
contents: cerberus.sys — EV code-signed kernel driver (WHQL certification pending)
The same cerberus_sdk.h you evaluated against
Unreal plugin and Unity package, with binaries
Your issued API key and title identifier

artifacts.name: Cerberus Evaluation SDK
artifacts.summary: Superseded by 0.6.0 and no longer published. 0.5.x source compiles against 0.6.0 unchanged; see the SDK changelog for what was added. Partners still on 0.5.1 should contact partner support before upgrading.
